claims.claim: NASA selected Kayla Barron, Chris Birch, Makoto Suwa, and Arutyun Kiviryan for Crew-14.
claims.episode_span: NASA selected Kayla Barron as spacecraft commander, Chris Birch as pilot, JAXA astronaut Makoto Suwa, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Arutyun Kiviryan.
claims.source_title: NASA announces four astronauts heading to ISS on SpaceX Crew-14 mission
claims.supporting_quote: NASA has revealed the names of the four astronauts who will be heading to the International Space Station (ISS) aboard SpaceX's Crew-14 mission , which is set to launch in 2027. The crew includes NASA astronauts Kayla Barron and Chris Birch, JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) astronaut Makoto Suwa, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Arutyun Kiviryan.

claims.claim: SpaceX completed the wet dress rehearsal for Starship Flight 14 on September 24.
claims.episode_span: The company loaded propellants and ran launch-day procedures on September 24 without engine ignition.
claims.source_title: SpaceX's megarocket Starship completes wet dress rehearsal ahead of Flight 14
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX has completed a key rehearsal ahead of Starship Flight 14, bringing the world's most powerful rocket closer to its first attempt to reach orbit. The company completed a wet dress rehearsal on September 24, loading propellants into the massive vehicle and running through launch-day procedures without firing its engines.

claims.claim: Flight 14 plans to deploy 26 next-generation Starlink satellites from the Ship upper stage.
claims.episode_span: Flight 14 targets an orbital insertion burn for the upper stage, six Earth orbits, and deployment of 26 next-generation Starlink satellites.
claims.source_title: SpaceX's megarocket Starship completes wet dress rehearsal ahead of Flight 14
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX also plans to deploy 26 next-generation Starlink satellites, giving the company its first chance to test these satellites from an orbital Starship mission.

claims.claim: The Dragon capsule for Crew-13 arrived at Pad 40 on September 25.
claims.episode_span: The refurbished capsule reached Pad 40 and will mate with its Falcon 9 booster.
claims.source_title: SpaceX Dragon spacecraft arrives at Cape Canaveral for October 1 launch of NASA’s Crew-13
claims.supporting_quote: SpaceX, on Thursday, announced a major update regarding NASA’s Crew-13 mission . The Dragon spacecraft that will carry four astronauts to the International Space Station (ISS) has arrived at Pad 40 at the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida and will soon be mated with the Falcon 9 rocket.

claims.claim: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite will fly on Transporter-18 and test Trillium TPUs in orbit.
claims.episode_span: The satellite will test Trillium TPUs in orbit, collecting data on launch vibration, radiation, and thermal performance.
claims.source_title: Project Suncatcher’s first AI satellite will test a tough cooling problem
claims.supporting_quote: Google’s first Project Suncatcher satellite will test whether its AI chips can shed heat in orbit. The prototype will collect data on launch stress, radiation and thermal extremes. Reuters reports the spacecraft will fly aboard SpaceX ’s Transporter-18 rideshare, with Planet Labs as a partner.
